title: Framingham: Eddie Curran and Christy's
summary: Bird cancels a Hi-Hat week in Boston, McGhee takes it and meets Eddie Curran, who flies him to Christy's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: 1951, yeah. But at that time, I was working up in Framingham.

At Christy's, yeah. He had a rhythm section up there and I used to go up there on weekends, because he liked me -- Eddie Curran, he liked me. I played up there... Oh, I forget what the hell is the name of this joint. It's right on Columbus and Mass...

The Hi-Hat. I went up there and played, because Bird was supposed to go up and play, and he called me up at the last minute and said he didn't want to go. So he asked me would I go up if he got me the connection and had the guy call me. I said, 'Well, you have the guy call.' So he called me, and I decided... I went on up and I played there for the week. Then the last night, some cat come in and says, 'There's a guy who wants to meet you, wants you to come out to his place.' And this was Christy's he was talking about.
That was like an after-hours place.

He would close up, then he'd run sessions after-hours with the guys that he wanted to be there.. So I went out there after we got off from work and met Eddie. And we liked each other immediately . he was very nice to me, treated me very nice, and I liked him because he treated me nice.

So I was laying up in bed one night and the phone rings; it's Eddie, it's 12 o'clock at night. I said, "Who in the hell is calling me at this time of night." It was Eddie. "Hey, Maggie," he says, "hop on the plane and come on up." I said, "Wait a minute. What do you mean? Come on up where? And what for?" So he said, "Look, you just come on up here; I'll take care of you." I said, "Well, okay, all right." So I got dressed and went and got on a plane and went on to Boston. When I got there he had a limousine waiting for me and a chauffeur and so forth, so they drove me out to Framingham. And I went out there, and he had a bunch of musicians out there, and they were jamming back...
